item.title: Tracker - Eurydice - Review: Unraveling a Year-Old Mystery
item.description: The latest episode of Tracker, “Eurydice,” delivers one of the series’ most emotionally complex stories to date, following Colter as he reopens a year-old missing child case that many in the town of Juliet, North Carolina, have long assumed ended in tragedy. The episode opens with a brief but unsettling scene: a woman waking up from a night of heavy drinking discovers her young daughter, Aubrey, is gone.
